## Human review verdict — chalbert/web-everything#1516

**Verdict:** 🚩 prevention outstanding — file the guard before accept

### Panel verdicts

| lens | weight | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | mandatory | prevention-outstanding |

### Findings (1)

**coverage** (1)
- `scripts/operations/verify.mjs:165` — The gate-forwarding wiring is verified only at the verify-io.mjs layer (verifyArgv/createChecksRunner); the operation's own `run: compute` step, which threads `view.input.gate` into the injected `runChecks()` call, has no test asserting that field actually reaches the runner. — A future edit to verify.mjs's `run: compute` fn (e.g. `fn: (view) => shapeRunFinding(runChecks({ cwd: view.input.checkout, mode: view.input.mode }))`, dropping `gate: view.input.gate`) would silently make every caller's supplied gate a no-op — the operation would run the home's DEFAULT suite while still reporting a green verdict, i.e. exactly the PR #1508 regression shape this whole PR exists to prevent. MUTATION PROBE: I applied exactly that one-line drop to scripts/operations/verify.mjs and ran the full `scripts/operations` vitest suite (26 files, 869 tests) — all 869 passed; NO named test reddens. The PR's own `verify.test.mjs` comment claims 'the runner carries the gate from its caller through to the argv... the PR #1510 blocker in one assertion' but that assertion exercises `createChecksRunner` directly with a hand-supplied `gate` argument — it never drives `verifyOperation`'s `run` step itself, so it cannot catch this specific drop. _[CONFIRMED]_ _[impact if unfixed: broken]_
  - _Prevention (OWED — file it):_ Add (or extend) a test that drives `verifyOperation({runChecks: spy})`'s `run` step through the engine (or calls its `fn` directly with a constructed `view`) and asserts the spy receives `gate` from `view.input.gate`, alongside similar checks for `checkout`/`mode` — closing the loop for every declared `reads` path, not just the ones re-tested one layer down. Longer-term, a mutation-testing pass (e.g. Stryker) scoped to `scripts/operations/*.mjs` step `fn` bodies would catch this whole class automatically.

---

**Decision:** `changes` — recorded by operator.
**Lens:** `correctness` — a SINGLE-LENS run. One `judge` step, one juror, one lens; the table above lists only the lens that judged. The other 3 panel lenses (security, simplicity, standards-conformance) did NOT run and are not reported as unjudged.
Net basis: `19e67126d7ac13e5c11820f2b088ae6363b05b5c..a5a37b22dae45c6d9a98d411212d5b022db35432` (rev `origin/lane/verify-gate-input` at review time) — 6 net changed file(s) vs current main (#2450), not `gh pr diff`'s three-dot list.
